notes.title: Update for Spring Sale
notes.notes:
In honor of the upcoming Spring Sale, I decided to make an update.

[list]
[*] You won't get achievements for most of the side stuff if you're on easy mode.
[*] Going further, you won't be gifted the things for Secret Reader if you're on easy mode. After all, the secret giver wants a show, and you're not entertaining them if you're doing things the easy way. They want you to struggle. I want you to struggle.
[*] Slime Grotesquerie has a little less HP. Speaking of Secret Reader, if you're chasing that, the boss won't buff itself on low HP, because I acknowledge that it's too hard since you won't have the endgame skills you'd usually have.
[*] Can no longer softlock self on the first floor with Rock Slimes. You'll need to leave and come back to reset everyone's positions, but hey, you can leave now.
[*] Most importantly... added a new secret achievement, if you choose to defy canon.
[/list]

Thanks to AliceEris, whose stream of this left me some ideas and pointed out that softlock.

notes.title: Bleed Update
notes.notes:
In honor of the Turn Based Fest, I've prepared a bit of an update!

Bleed now works like how it does in I Hate You, Please Suffer, with enemies taking fixed-ish damage at the end of every turn. This means that bleed is now far more meaningful to inflict on normal enemies while not chewing through boss health. A result of this is that health has generally been rebalanced across the board.

Guns are now rebalanced, too. Wielding a revolver makes Julius faster than everyone else, while he's slower than some enemies with the shotgun equipped. The biggest change though is that his Warning Shot's guaranteed to go last in the turn rotation - gotta risk it a bit before you can get that stun off, now.

Some other noteworthy changes and fixes:
[list]
[*] Zeus81 fullscreen script added.
[*] Calm Aura buffed to raise accuracy. Use it to counter being Blind, or maybe you badly want to land a Bleed on an evasive jerk.
[*] Fixed occurrence on Floor 15 where a battle happens twice.
[*] Fixed the conversation at the last rest stop repeating on second use.
[*] King Slime can no longer berserk self since it removes rest of its moveset.
[*] Third boss' backup now revived at full health, though they're capable of being stunned again. Disgusted Slime replaced by a regular Slime.
[/list]

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
I think I finally figured out how to update this game without things exploding, please hit me up if something exploded. The changes in the update include:

[list]
[*] Increased hit rate for revolver and shotgun; you'll still need to lean on Take Aim to deal with high evasion enemies, though.
[*] Vastly increased hit rate for the endgame buff skills to make using them more worth it.
[*] Lowered health of the second boss enemies a bit to make it more manageable.
[*] Edited some text
[*] Added two new secret achievements
[/list]

Also I finally got to set a sale for this, so it's going to be 20% off for the upcoming weeklong sale. I mean, you probably already have it if you're reading this, but it'd be nice to let people you know about it.
